fit: oral turmeric extract and rearing in rotenone rats
assessment: Figure 5 and the post hoc analysis report no detected rearing difference between extract and rotenone alone. The three-arm paper reports electrophysiology and spontaneous movement, with no bar latency or passive rigidity outcome.

assessment: Cell death and oxidative measures worsened in the specified coexposure experiment. This is adverse mechanistic context without an observed rigidity response.
